name: Academic Dispute — "You may have it gain reach" is a toggle on the spell, reach only for the target
notes: Memory: project_may_action_behind_toggle_2026-10-11. "Target creature blocks this turn if able. You may have it gain reach until end of turn." The reach was a global effect that could not be declined. It is now behind a toggle labelled with the offer, resolved to the spell's target; here the toggle is at Yes and only the target has reach.
